basic_details.job_title: KASE Company Secretary Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online

qualification.details: Applicant must be a citizen of India. | The qualification stipulated for the post must be from a recognised University/Institute. Applicants having qualifications equivalent to any of the prescribed qualifications must submit an equivalency certificate issued by the competent authority; without such a certificate, their candidature will not be considered. | 3 years of post-qualification experience as on 01.10.2026. Experience acquired after the date of passing of the stipulated qualification shall only be considered. In the case of current experience, applicants may upload an affidavit with details of the employer, designation, period, nature of job, tasks, and responsibilities.

salary_details.details: The position is offered on a contract basis with a consolidated pay.

selection_process: The selection will be based on an interview of the shortlisted candidates. However
KASE/CMD reserves its right to opt for an additional selection process
The applications will be subjected to scrutiny based on the details provided by the candidate

and a list of candidates eligible for further selection processes will be prepared. KASE/CMD reserves the right to shortlist only a limited number of candidates for the selection process based on the relevancy of experience
and overall suitability of the candidates to the position.
how_to_apply: Visit the official website of the Centre for Management Development (CMD), Thiruvananthapuram at cmd.kerala.gov.in.
Go to the online application portal for KASE Company Secretary Recruitment 2026.
Fill out the prescribed application form with all required details accurately.
Upload your updated Curriculum Vitae (CV), passport size photograph (taken within six months), signature, and copies of certificates proving qualification and experience in the specified formats.
Review all entered information to ensure there are no discrepancies before final submission.
Submit the online application form before 05:00 P.M. on 13 October 2026.
Save or note down the application reference number and take a confirmation printout or screenshot of the submission message for future correspondence.
important_instructions: No application will be entertained at the office of KASE/CMD if submitted either online or offline through any channel other than the designated online portal. KASE/CMD reserves the right to fill or not fill the post advertised without assigning any reason. Admittance to various stages of recruitment is provisional only and does not confer any claim until all conditions are satisfied. Furnishing any false, tampered, or fabricated information or suppressing material information will result in the rejection of candidature. Applicants must have a valid personal email ID and mobile number active throughout the recruitment process. The copy of appointment letters, salary certificates, pay slips, etc., will not be accepted in lieu of a work experience certificate. KASE reserves the right to modify, cancel the notification, or revise the number of posts at any time without assigning any reason.

content_sections.heading: KASE Company Secretary Vacancy Details (Post-wise)
content_sections.text: There is a total of 1 vacancy available for the post under this notification.

content_sections.heading: KASE Company Secretary Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Applicant must be a citizen of India. The qualification stipulated for the post must be from a recognised University/Institute. Applicants having qualifications equivalent to any of the prescribed qualifications must submit an equivalency certificate issued by the competent authority; without such a certificate, their candidature will not be considered. 3 years of post-qualification experience as on 01.10.2026. Experience acquired after the date of passing of the stipulated qualification shall only be considered. In the case of current experience, applicants may upload an affidavit with details of the employer, designation, period, nature of job, tasks, and responsibilities.

rows.qualification_required: Member of Institute of Company Secretaries of India.

content_sections.heading: KASE Company Secretary Salary
content_sections.text: The position is offered on a contract basis with a consolidated pay.

content_sections.heading: KASE Company Secretary Selection Process
content_sections.text: The selection will be based on an interview of the shortlisted candidates. However, KASE/CMD reserves its right to opt for an additional selection process, if required. The applications will be subjected to scrutiny based on the details provided by the candidate, and a list of candidates eligible for further selection processes will be prepared. KASE/CMD reserves the right to shortlist only a limited number of candidates for the selection process based on the relevancy of experience, quality of academic achievements, and overall suitability of the candidates to the position.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for KASE Company Secretary
content_sections.text: Visit the official website of the Centre for Management Development (CMD), Thiruvananthapuram at cmd.kerala.gov.in. Go to the online application portal for KASE Company Secretary Recruitment 2026. Fill out the prescribed application form with all required details accurately. Upload your updated Curriculum Vitae (CV), passport size photograph (taken within six months), signature, and copies of certificates proving qualification and experience in the specified formats. Review all entered information to ensure there are no discrepancies before final submission. Submit the online application form before 05:00 P.M. on 13 October 2026. Save or note down the application reference number and take a confirmation printout or screenshot of the submission message for future correspondence.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required
content_sections.text: Updated Curriculum Vitae (CV) Passport size photograph (taken within six months, in JPEG format, less than 200kB) Signature (in JPEG format, less than 50kB) Copies of certificates proving educational qualification and experience (in JPEG or PDF format, not exceeding 3MB each) Affidavit with details of employer, designation, period, nature of job, tasks, and responsibilities (in case of current experience) Equivalency certificate issued by the competent authority (if applicable)

content_sections.heading: KASE Company Secretary Important Instructions
content_sections.text: No application will be entertained at the office of KASE/CMD if submitted either online or offline through any channel other than the designated online portal. KASE/CMD reserves the right to fill or not fill the post advertised without assigning any reason. Admittance to various stages of recruitment is provisional only and does not confer any claim until all conditions are satisfied. Furnishing any false, tampered, or fabricated information or suppressing material information will result in the rejection of candidature. Applicants must have a valid personal email ID and mobile number active throughout the recruitment process. The copy of appointment letters, salary certificates, pay slips, etc., will not be accepted in lieu of a work experience certificate. KASE reserves the right to modify, cancel the notification, or revise the number of posts at any time without assigning any reason.

faq.question: Q1. What is KASE Company Secretary Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: It is a recruitment notification issued by the Kerala Academy for Skills Excellence (KASE) to hire one qualified candidate for the post of Company Secretary on a contract basis.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in KASE Company Secretary Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy available for the Company Secretary post.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply online for KASE Company Secretary Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date for submitting the online application is 13 October 2026 up to 05:00 P.M.

faq.question: Q4. What is the educational qualification required for the KASE Company Secretary post?
faq.answer: Candidates must be a member of the Institute of Company Secretaries of India (ICSI).

faq.question: Q5. How much experience is required to apply?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess 3 years of post-qualification experience as on 01.10.2026.
